sites.name: start-strip-operators
sites.find:
strip0 -= arc * effect_scale * 10.0f;
                    strip1 += arc * effect_scale * 10.0f;

replacements.name: assign-expression
replacements.text:
strip0 = strip0 - arc * effect_scale * 10.0f;
                    strip1 = strip1 + arc * effect_scale * 10.0f;

replacements.name: named-result-copy

sites.name: end-strip-operators
sites.find:
strip2 += arc * effect_scale * 10.0f;
                    strip3 -= arc * effect_scale * 10.0f;

replacements.name: assign-expression
replacements.text:
strip2 = strip2 + arc * effect_scale * 10.0f;
                    strip3 = strip3 - arc * effect_scale * 10.0f;

replacements.name: named-result-copy
